purpose: Implement the whole approved change inside the unit's worktree (ticketless path).
instructions: Work only inside the dispatched worktree path and record the branch and path in worktree.md in the stage directory. Implement the approved change and run the full test and static-check commands. When returning from a failed verification, address the failing output (and the review findings, when the failure came from the review stage) against the whole change.
restrictions: MUST NOT write routing state (state.json) or the event log (log.ndjson).
MUST NOT write .harness/ (current-truth documents, ledger, config, graph definition) or any long-term memory.
MUST NOT run any VCS operation: no git commit, branch, staging, or worktree command, and never the worktree script.
MUST confine repository writes to the worktree path given in the dispatch; the stage directory stays writable. Report blocked when no usable worktree path is given.
